77c8cc57-95c1-4f9b-8843-493eb2697566.title: Souzai Saishuka no Isekai Ryokouki
77c8cc57-95c1-4f9b-8843-493eb2697566.description:
Takeru Kamishiro is a normal guy with an ordinary office job, but one day finds himself summoned to another world. Takeru starts his new life in "Madeus", a world with swords and magic, fully equipped with multiple skills! Not only does he have enhanced physical and amazing magic abilities, but also the power to "search" for valuable items. 

With the cheat skills he's been provided, Takeru starts his new adventure in the new world!!

chapters.title: Descent - The Spirit Sovereign of the Forest

a972aebe-50fb-4dfe-8f61-0150f3659467.title: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes
a972aebe-50fb-4dfe-8f61-0150f3659467.description:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

---
I was the only younger sister of the female protagonist in the reverse harem novel. In addition, I was exceptionally pampered by the female lead after waking up after being very sick. I used that to defeat the original inexcusable trash male leads who only hurt my sister…

‘Lili, how are you? Do you like cake?’

‘Lili is really pretty because she resembles her sister. Won’t you eat cookies? Please tell your sister that these were given to you by your wonderful brother.’

‘Would you like to eat this and go over there for a while? I have something to say to your uncle and sister.’

For some reason, the male lead candidates seem anxious to see me.

**

“I don’t play with ugly kids," the boy in front of me muttered with a deep frown.

What? Did you really just say that? I’ll show you what the real world is like.

I gently pulled the hem of my sister’s clothes and shook my head, “I hate him, so I hate the older brother who brought him.”

At the same time, Cedric’s face turned pale, similar to someone who had been sentenced to death.

5210fbb8-c19b-4237-b397-6c0e820b7b71.title: I Want to Be the Director's Husband
5210fbb8-c19b-4237-b397-6c0e820b7b71.altTitle: I Want to Be the CEO's Husband
5210fbb8-c19b-4237-b397-6c0e820b7b71.description: "Ayo kita menikah sekali saja." Ju Hyeon, seorang aktor rookie menerima proposal pernikahan dari Kang Ahjin, CEO dari perusahaan jasa security terbaik di Korea Selatan. Namun, proposal itu ternyata bukan berdasarkan cinta melainkan niat balas dendam kepada pembunuh orang tuanya. Sebagai gantinya, Kang Ahjin pun menjanjikan peran dan kesuksesan Ju Hyeon sebagai aktor. Hanya satu hal yang menjadi syarat proposal pernikahan ini: Dilarang jatuh cinta! Bisakah mereka mempertahankan aturan tersebut dan mencapai tujuan mereka masing-masing? Atau salah satu dari mereka berakhir jatuh cinta dan menghancurkan segalanya?

ca84bb81-8a23-4b49-8aff-b2ab6761d0cd.title: Higan de Rendezvous
ca84bb81-8a23-4b49-8aff-b2ab6761d0cd.description:
New hire Tamada Mei has been assigned to the Ghost Spot Tour Planning Division!

With her innate ability to see spirits, she'll find many reasons to tremble... including Ichika, the handsome senpai in her unit, who makes her heart flutter. What will the two of them encounter in all these haunted locations...?!

1955f9bf-f849-4f53-a1f4-c1b79c906212.title: KaguRai ~Kagura to Raito~
1955f9bf-f849-4f53-a1f4-c1b79c906212.description: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the blade. And Raito is a boy who belongs to the race called "Nin'you" that is hated by the humans. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends, until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. For the sake of them living together. The bond between the two transcends years, walls, races, reality! Surpass it all!!

6567955a-a5b8-4ad9-ad54-c08ecd42f9c0.title: Sesang e Nappeun Yongsaneun Eopda
6567955a-a5b8-4ad9-ad54-c08ecd42f9c0.altTitle: There Are No Bad Heroes in This World
6567955a-a5b8-4ad9-ad54-c08ecd42f9c0.description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. 

A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. 

Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

7ef34127-632d-4f71-b371-618973b0ae77.title: Otis
7ef34127-632d-4f71-b371-618973b0ae77.description:
Lee Si-an is a woman who was cursed to die in May, the month when her entire family was massacred.

Perhaps it was fate. Or perhaps it was a bad relationship.

Tae Go-on, is a dangerous man who promises to save her. His boiling possessiveness was focused solely on her.

c0727be3-cccf-4cfd-99de-13c52c0f23be.title: Kyomu-neechan wa Kamatte Hoshii
c0727be3-cccf-4cfd-99de-13c52c0f23be.description:
The boy's friend is a beautiful 32-year-old NEET.

Yamaguchi-kun is an ordinary boy, but he has a friend. She’s his neighbor, a very beautiful older woman known a "Kyomu-nee." However, her true nature is that of a useless person—a jobless NEET and heavy drinker who spends day and night lamenting life without working!!
Having ended up being liked by Kyomu-nee, Yamaguchi-kun tries to keep things at the level of friendship, but her complete lack of boundaries leaves him blushing every day. 
At this rate, it feels like she might end up warping his tastes…!?

A heavy-drinking, jobless NEET, yet beautiful and with far too many openings!!! A cute neighbor comedy where she depends on you!!!!

chapters.title: Empty Nee-chan Wants to be Coddled

18878c4e-65f0-40b8-9e58-2d647f16d485.title: Melanco Killing
18878c4e-65f0-40b8-9e58-2d647f16d485.description:
Amane Shougo, a con artist belonging to the criminal organization Filching Owl, revelled in the sense of superiority he felt from deceiving and controlling others.
Setting his sights on a new target, Shougo moves in closer. However, it turns out to be a trap laid to capture him——.
Standing at the brink of death, Shougo makes a certain proposal…
